policy.default: Run the changed cluster's deterministic checks first and collect all failures before editing.
policy.generatedArtifacts: Generate and check once after all canonical semantic-source decisions are complete.
policy.visual: Run only the impacted journey and viewport matrix after the owning UI cluster is stable.
policy.fullGate: Defer full frontend/backend static, build and release gates to G5 immediately before head freeze.
policy.w1: Run exactly once in G6 against the frozen frontend/backend head pair.
policy.agent: Do not run the agent full gate unless agent source or an agent-consumed contract pin changes.

clusters.escalateWhen: Canonical authorization source, release lineage, migration seed effect, or generated contract changes.
nextChecks: Run the complete :dwp-auth-server:test task once after all authorization dispositions and V242 are stable.
Regenerate authorization, seed and fixtures once in G3; then run their byte/checksum guards.

clusters.escalateWhen: The Assignment API, authority boundary, schema, or People V49..V53 migration sequence changes.
nextChecks: Run People clean-install/upgrade migration checks only after the immutable V49..V52 admission is placed.
Stop if an environment reports V53 without all V49..V52 predecessors.

clusters.escalateWhen: Gateway route, step-up, trusted tenant context, or public projection changes.
nextChecks: Run the complete :dwp-gateway:test task only after all gateway conflicts are disposed.

clusters.escalateWhen: An owner controller or schema changes the public contract.
nextChecks: After backend canonical semantics are stable, run `DWP_EXPORT_AUTH_OPENAPI=true ./gradlew :dwp-auth-server:test --tests com.dwp.services.auth.config.AuthOpenApiSnapshotExportTest` exactly once.

In the same one-time generation batch, run `DWP_EXPORT_PLATFORM_OPENAPI=true ./gradlew :dwp-platform-server:test --tests com.dwp.services.platform.config.PlatformOpenApiSnapshotExportTest` exactly once.
Retain evidence that each selected export test executed and was not skipped.
Run frontend yarn openapi:check after the exported contract pins are fixed.

clusters.escalateWhen: Visible identity, Home application catalog, or Platform migration effect changes.
nextChecks: Keep current V321; do not admit byte-identical reconciled V320.

firstChecks: Review each dual-changed path and assign it to an owning cluster before executing a test.
clusters.escalateWhen: A path affects a shared contract or runtime topology.
nextChecks: Use the owning module's targeted test task; do not create a catch-all rerun.

clusters.escalateWhen: Backend canonical authorization output or frontend projection changes.
nextChecks: Run the three projection checks once more only if their pinned backend inputs change.

clusters.escalateWhen: Assignment API shape, proposal state machine, or authority decision changes.
nextChecks: Run only the changed Assignment browser journey after the model tests pass.

clusters.escalateWhen: Launchpad identity, route, Home contribution, or shell registry changes.
nextChecks: Preserve the visible product identity HRIS.
Run the impacted Home/Shell Playwright journey only after unit/model tests pass.

clusters.escalateWhen: A locale key, visible identity, or route label changes.
nextChecks: Check only changed locale files for key parity before running any browser journey.

firstChecks: Do not choose a snapshot side during G1/G2; resolve the owning UI semantics first.
In G4 run only the named impacted Playwright spec at 1440, 1280, 390 and 320 px plus 200% zoom and required accessibility modes.
clusters.escalateWhen: The owning Home, Shell, Assignment, or Authorization UI result changes.
nextChecks: Update binary snapshots once after the owning journey is approved; never use a blanket snapshot update.

firstChecks: Review each dual-changed path and assign it to an owning feature before executing a test.
clusters.escalateWhen: A path crosses a feature boundary or generated contract.
nextChecks: Use the owning feature's named Vitest files; do not run the full Vitest suite for classification.

promotionSequence: G3 one-time canonical generation and contract checks
G4 cluster-local frontend and impacted visual checks
G5 full deterministic frontend/backend static-build-release gates and head freeze
G6 one W1 runtime pass on the frozen head pair
G7 evidence-only promotion and module packet issuance
